provenance_note: Utilisation per pane and load case, governing case and pane were computed by bench-src/ref/gen_glassthickness.py, written from NBN S 23-002-2:2020 (§4.2–4.5, §8.5, §9.2, §10.2–10.4, Tab. 1, 5, 7, 24, 32, 39), NBN S 23-002-3:2020 (§3.2, Tab. 1–3) and EN 16612:2019 Annex B, not from the page code: the reference takes the printed extreme isochoric pressures of Tab. 24 / 32 (the page recombines the Tab. 21 / 29 components with eq. (69)–(76)), the printed φ of eq. (9)(10) and the closed form of Tab. 7 for double units, and solves the two cavity balances of eq. (28) directly for triple units. Three cells of the NBN S 23-002-3 §5 tables (composition printed for that size) must pass. r2-fix: part 4 cases (eq. (1)(2)(5)–(7), Ψp from the printed Tab. 1.a rows, Gint,d of NBN S 23-002-5 Tab. 1 log-linear, pane temperatures 11 / 20,2 °C), single roof panes (§10.5 Tab. 41 + uplift + self-weight alone; the roof cp, snow defaults and s·cos²θ are the tool learning assumptions and are taken over as inputs, so they are shared, not checked), printed Tab. 6 hef and Tab. 1 kmod values, and 26 tabulated cells of NBN S 23-002-3 / -5 §5 (the tabulated composition passes, the next thinner of the same row fails; cells taken in a fixed order from the middle of each table, none skipped). Not in the independent path: 3-edge plates (§5.3 Tab. 17), roof insulating units (§10.6) and the EN 16612 set — covered by the engine tests only. The triple-unit cavity balance has the same structure as the page (solved directly, not by the Tab. 10 closed forms).
